posts.text:
Delighted to present two papers at COLM 2026 workshops. We also had a chance to show a few demos at the Amazon booth and speak with many PhD students and scientists looking for new opportunities in the Generative AI space. Our work covered:

Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute (https://lnkd.in/gJvaiZ4g)
> We benchmark test-time prompt transformation methods to identify which deliver the best accuracy per $ spent.

Impact of Expert Training Duration on Model Merging for LLMs (https://lnkd.in/gsTCdu_T)
> We find that for some merging methods, the merged model accuracy is the best when we overfit the expert LLMs

Kudos to my co-authors on this work: Nikita Kozodoi, PhD and Zainab A.

Excited to present 3 papers on LLM optimization, scaling and merging at COLM in San Francisco! 🇺🇸 

Always happy to chat with fellow scientists at the Amazon booth and exchange ideas on where the field is going, and how to keep up with the speed of research.

Kudos to my co-authors from the AWS FDE team: Jack Butler, Zainab A., Egor Krasheninnikov, Sergey I., Natalia Tarasova
Great energy at AWS Summit Dubai! It was inspiring to meet so many builders and showcase our team’s work to customers across the region.
